limitations: Site shows no replay benchmark numbers, Lean receipt or GPU result unless demo.json carries them; none of those were available on this branch. They render as unavailable.
Full-data route analysis is descriptive (labels from the whole table), not a predictive benchmark.
Interval parameter kappa/epsilon is an ASSUMED sensitivity; two replicates do not give simultaneous confidence bands.
Browser blocked-status is stricter than core's (unmeasured genotypes allowed to be perfect); on pairs tested the closed-set sizes agree (25 at kappa=6) but this is not proved in general.
Packed scores are int16 at 2e-5 resolution; borderline margins below ~2e-5 may differ from core's exact micro-unit integers.
Nanopub drafts are unsigned and unpublished; no trusty URI, no network submission, no observed external reuse.

ALDE was read (PMC11739421, via fetch summary of first 100k chars); FLIP2 and arXiv:2604.22611 only via fetched page/abstract summaries; PELLM not inspected. Comparison is qualitative; no head-to-head run.
No dark-theme or screen-reader audit beyond keyboard access to the tile inspector, route-step buttons and controls; mobile checked at 390 px width only.
Company wedge is a hypothesis; no market size, customer or willingness-to-pay data exists in the repo.
